---
title: "USCIS Processing Times"
subtitle: "Collated from daily snapshots of what USCIS published"
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    scrolling: false
    theme:
      light: [cosmo, custom.scss]
      dark: [cosmo, custom.scss, dark.scss]
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    dev: png
    dev.args:
      bg: transparent
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
library(DBI); library(RSQLite); library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(htmltools)

# Both come from the environment. A baked-in default would ship one machine's
# absolute paths, and the archive filename is itself a detail about the source.
PANEL <- Sys.getenv("USCIS_PANEL", unset = "")
if (!nzchar(PANEL)) {
  stop("USCIS_PANEL is not set. Point it at the published panel .db.", call. = FALSE)
}
RAW <- Sys.getenv("USCIS_RAW_SNAPSHOT", unset = "")   # optional; the panel carries offices

con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), PANEL)
onx <- function(x) as.Date(x, origin = "1970-01-01")

snap <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT snapshot_date, form_name, office_code, form_subtype,
  range_lower_months lo, range_upper_months up, range_lower_reason lo_reason,
  range_valid, subtype_info_en, publication_date, service_request_date,
  range_upper_unit FROM pt_snapshots")
snap$snapshot_date <- onx(snap$snapshot_date)
# USCIS stamps each estimate with the day it computed it, and separately names the
# date a case must predate before you may call. Both are published; neither is shown.
snap$age_days <- as.numeric(snap$snapshot_date) - snap$publication_date
snap$implied_up <- (as.numeric(snap$snapshot_date) - snap$service_request_date) / 30.44

cov <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT date, absent, n_rows FROM coverage ORDER BY date")
cov$date <- onx(cov$date)

disc <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT form_name, office_code, form_subtype, event_type,
  event_date, status FROM disclosure_events")
disc$event_date <- onx(disc$event_date)

evts <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT form_name, office_code, form_subtype, event_date,
  prev_upper_months pu, new_upper_months nu, delta_upper_months du,
  delta_lower_months dl, direction FROM pt_events WHERE delta_upper_months IS NOT NULL")
evts$event_date <- onx(evts$event_date)

inq <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT form_name, office_code, form_subtype, snapshot_date,
  observed_delta_days, anomaly_class FROM inquiry_events WHERE anomaly_class <> 'normal'")
inq$snapshot_date <- onx(inq$snapshot_date)
dbDisconnect(con)

# office code -> human name, recovered from a raw snapshot (the panel carries codes only)
# The panel carries the office dimension, folded across every snapshot era, so
# retired offices keep the name they were last published under. Older panels
# predate that table, hence the fallback to a raw snapshot.
offnm <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con2 <- dbConnect(SQLite(), PANEL, flags = SQLITE_RO),
                             "SELECT code, description FROM offices"),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(offnm)) try(dbDisconnect(con2), silent = TRUE)
if (is.null(offnm) || !nrow(offnm)) {
  offnm <- tryCatch({
    c2 <- dbConnect(SQLite(), RAW); on.exit(dbDisconnect(c2))
    dbGetQuery(c2, "SELECT code, description FROM offices")
  }, error = function(e) data.frame(code = character(), description = character()))
}

PAL <- c(teal = "#1E8FB8", crimson = "#C13A5E", olive = "#6E9B2A", violet = "#8B62B8")
# ggplot renders to a transparent PNG that must sit on either theme, so its ink
# is a mid tone legible on both and its grid is translucent rather than a colour.
INK   <- "#8A939E"
MUTED <- "#7E8894"
GRID  <- grDevices::adjustcolor("#8A939E", alpha.f = .26)

# office code -> readable name, used in every table so no bare acronyms are shown
OFFNAME <- setNames(offnm$description, offnm$code)
oname <- function(x) { n <- unname(OFFNAME[x]); ifelse(is.na(n), x, n) }

theme_panel <- function(base = 11.5) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base) + theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = MUTED, size = base - 1.5, margin = margin(b = 9)),
    plot.caption = element_text(colour = MUTED, size = base - 2.5, hjust = 0,
                                margin = margin(t = 9)),
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = GRID, linewidth = .38),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = MUTED, size = base - 2),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = MUTED, size = base - 2.5),
    legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(colour = INK, size = base - 1.5),
    legend.margin = margin(b = -4),
    strip.text = element_text(colour = INK, face = "bold", size = base - 1.5),
    plot.margin = margin(4, 8, 2, 2))
}
mo <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(format(round(x, d), nsmall = d), " mo")

# Renders a themed HTML table. Reactable ships its own light palette and loads
# after the theme bundle, so it cannot follow a dark/light toggle; this markup
# reads the same CSS tokens as everything else and switches for free.
dt_table <- function(df, right = character(), bold = character(),
                     mono = character(), colour = list(), note = NULL,
                     prose = character()) {
  th <- paste0("<th", ifelse(names(df) %in% right, ' class="r"', ""), ">",
               names(df), "</th>", collapse = "")
  body <- apply(df, 1, function(row) {
    cells <- vapply(names(df), function(nm) {
      cls <- c(if (nm %in% right) "r", if (nm %in% bold) "b", if (nm %in% mono) "k",
               if (nm %in% prose) "prose")
      val <- htmltools::htmlEscape(row[[nm]])
      if (!is.null(colour[[nm]])) cls <- c(cls, colour[[nm]](val))
      sprintf('<td class="%s">%s</td>', paste(cls, collapse = " "), val)
    }, character(1))
    paste0("<tr>", paste(cells, collapse = ""), "</tr>")
  })
  # the note sits outside the scroller: inside it the flex container squeezes it
  htmltools::HTML(sprintf(
    '<div class="dt-box"><div class="dt-scroll"><table class="dt"><thead><tr>%s</tr></thead><tbody>%s</tbody></table></div>%s</div>',
    th, paste(body, collapse = ""),
    if (is.null(note)) "" else sprintf('<div class="chart-note">%s</div>', note)))
}


latest <- max(snap$snapshot_date)
cur <- snap[snap$snapshot_date == latest, ]
OFFICE_FORMS <- c("N-400", "I-485", "N-600", "N-600K")
PSEUDO <- c("SCD", "NBC", "FOD", "IPO", "IOP", "EFC")
# minimum recorded backslides before a form is worth ranking on severity
BW_FLOOR <- 40

# ---- every figure quoted anywhere on this dashboard is derived here, so the
# ---- copy stays true when the panel is rebuilt on newer snapshots.
present <- cov[cov$absent == 0, ]
drops <- present |> arrange(date) |> mutate(chg = n_rows - lag(n_rows)) |> filter(!is.na(chg))
big_drop <- drops |> slice_min(chg, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
run_len <- with(rle(cov$absent), max(c(0, lengths[values == 1])))
retired <- c("CSC","NSC","SSC","ESC","YSC")
ret_last <- suppressWarnings(max(snap$snapshot_date[snap$office_code %in% retired]))
worst_row <- cur |> filter(!is.na(up)) |> slice_max(up, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
bw_all <- inq |> filter(anomaly_class == "backward")
bw <- inq |> filter(anomaly_class == "backward")
disc_day <- disc |> filter(event_type == "disappeared") |>
  count(event_date, sort = TRUE) |> slice_head(n = 1)
inverted_keys <- snap |> filter(range_valid == 0) |>
  distinct(form_name, office_code, form_subtype) |> nrow()

S <- list(
  snapshots  = length(unique(snap$snapshot_date)),
  rows       = nrow(snap),
  forms      = n_distinct(snap$form_name),
  start      = format(min(snap$snapshot_date)), end = format(latest),
  peak       = max(present$n_rows), now = present$n_rows[which.max(present$date)],
  absent     = sum(cov$absent), absent_run = run_len,
  drop_date  = format(big_drop$date), drop_size = abs(big_drop$chg),
  drop_from  = big_drop$n_rows - big_drop$chg, drop_to = big_drop$n_rows,
  ret_last   = if (is.finite(ret_last)) format(ret_last) else NA_character_,
  ret_n      = length(retired),
  worst_v    = round(worst_row$up), worst_form = worst_row$form_name,
  worst_off  = oname(worst_row$office_code),
  bw_n       = nrow(bw),
  bw_keys    = n_distinct(paste(bw$form_name, bw$office_code, bw$form_subtype)),
  bw_days    = n_distinct(bw$snapshot_date),
  rescued    = sum(snap$lo_reason == "missing_value", na.rm = TRUE),
  invalid    = sum(snap$range_valid == 0), invalid_keys = inverted_keys,
  disc_day   = format(disc_day$event_date), disc_day_n = disc_day$n,
  office_forms = paste(OFFICE_FORMS, collapse = ", ")
)
S$pct_fall <- round((S$peak - S$now) / S$peak * 100, 1)
S$false_disc <- format(signif(S$bw_keys * S$absent, 2), big.mark = ",")
fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
```

```{r}
#| label: ojs-payloads
#| output: false

# --- per-office first vs last, for every form that has a real office dimension
off <- snap |>
  filter(form_name %in% OFFICE_FORMS, !is.na(up), range_valid == 1,
         !office_code %in% PSEUDO, nchar(office_code) == 3) |>
  group_by(form_name, form_subtype, office_code) |>
  arrange(snapshot_date) |>
  summarise(first_up = first(up), last_up = last(up),
            first_lo = first(lo), last_lo = last(lo), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(offnm, by = c("office_code" = "code")) |>
  mutate(office_name = ifelse(is.na(description), office_code, description),
         label = paste0(form_name, " · ", form_subtype),
         delta = last_up - first_up)

# --- monthly series for EVERY form, so the explorer covers all 44
series <- snap |>
  filter(!is.na(up)) |>
  mutate(ym = format(snapshot_date, "%Y-%m")) |>
  group_by(form_name, form_subtype, office_code, ym) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(form = form_name, subtype = form_subtype, office = office_code,
            ym, lo = round(lo, 2), up = round(up, 2))

form_index <- snap |>
  filter(snapshot_date == latest) |>
  group_by(form_name) |>
  summarise(offices = n_distinct(office_code), subtypes = n_distinct(form_subtype),
            worst = suppressWarnings(max(up, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(worst = ifelse(is.finite(worst), worst, NA_real_)) |>
  arrange(form_name)

desc <- snap |> filter(snapshot_date == latest) |>
  distinct(form_name, form_subtype, subtype_info_en)

offname_tbl <- data.frame(code = names(OFFNAME), name = unname(OFFNAME),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# --- backslides: monthly, zero-filled so the quiet stretches stay visible.
#     Backward moves land in bursts on a handful of release days, so daily
#     spikes render as hairlines; monthly bins give the bars real width.
bwx <- inq |> filter(anomaly_class == "backward")
bwm <- bwx |>
  mutate(ym = format(snapshot_date, "%Y-%m")) |>
  group_by(ym) |>
  summarise(events  = n(),
            keys    = n_distinct(paste(form_name, office_code, form_subtype)),
            days    = n_distinct(snapshot_date),
            mean_d  = round(mean(abs(observed_delta_days))),
            worst_d = round(max(abs(observed_delta_days))), .groups = "drop")
bwm <- data.frame(ym = format(seq(min(bwx$snapshot_date), max(bwx$snapshot_date),
                                  by = "month"), "%Y-%m"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  left_join(bwm, by = "ym") |>
  mutate(across(-ym, \(v) ifelse(is.na(v), 0, v))) |>
  arrange(ym)

# --- backslides: per form, every form clearing the 40-event floor
bwf <- bwx |>
  group_by(form_name) |>
  summarise(events  = n(), offices = n_distinct(office_code),
            mean_d  = round(mean(abs(observed_delta_days)), 1),
            med_d   = round(median(abs(observed_delta_days))),
            worst_d = round(max(abs(observed_delta_days))), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(events >= BW_FLOOR) |> arrange(desc(mean_d))

bwnote <- data.frame(
  monthly = sprintf(paste("The case-inquiry date is the date USCIS tells you to wait for before",
                          "calling about a pending case. It normally advances one day per day.",
                          "When an estimate is revised it can move backwards, so a cohort that",
                          "could call yesterday cannot today. Bars count keys moved backwards in",
                          "each month: %s moves across %s keys, landing on %s release days out of",
                          "the whole archive. Hover a bar for that month's detail."),
                    fmt(S$bw_n), fmt(S$bw_keys), fmt(S$bw_days)),
  perform = sprintf(paste("Every form with at least %s recorded backslides, %s of them.",
                          "Bars are the mean days the inquiry date moved backwards per event.",
                          "Hover a bar for the median and the worst single move."),
                    BW_FLOOR, nrow(bwf)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# --- disclosure: withdrawals per year, split by how firmly they are established
dwd <- disc |> filter(event_type == "disappeared")
dpeak <- dwd |> count(event_date, name = "n") |>
  mutate(year = format(event_date, "%Y")) |>
  group_by(year) |> slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  transmute(year, peak_day = format(event_date), peak_n = n) |> ungroup()

dyear <- dwd |> mutate(year = format(event_date, "%Y")) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(confirmed   = sum(status == "confirmed"),
            provisional = sum(status == "provisional"),
            forms   = n_distinct(form_name),
            offices = n_distinct(office_code), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(dpeak, by = "year") |> arrange(year)

# --- disclosure: which forms lost the most keys
dform <- dwd |> group_by(form_name) |>
  summarise(keys = n(), offices = n_distinct(office_code),
            subtypes = n_distinct(form_subtype),
            first = format(min(event_date)), last = format(max(event_date)),
            .groups = "drop") |> arrange(desc(keys)) |> slice_head(n = 12)

discnote <- data.frame(
  byyear = sprintf(paste("Bars count keys that stopped being published, by the year they went.",
                         "A key only counts once it is missing from two snapshots in a row, so a",
                         "day the feed was unreachable is never read as a withdrawal. Without",
                         "that rule the %s missing days would have produced about %s false ones.",
                         "%s withdrawals in all, of which %s were later reversed."),
                   S$absent, S$false_disc, fmt(nrow(dwd)),
                   sum(disc$event_type == "retracted")),
  byform = sprintf(paste("The %s forms that lost the most keys. Most losses are office",
                         "granularity rather than a form being discontinued. The heaviest",
                         "single day was %s with %s withdrawals."),
                   nrow(dform), S$disc_day, S$disc_day_n),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- new analyses
OFFICE_ONLY <- function(d) d[nchar(d$office_code) == 3 & !d$office_code %in% PSEUDO, ]

# --- spread across offices at the latest snapshot, per office form
spread <- OFFICE_ONLY(cur) |>
  filter(form_name %in% OFFICE_FORMS, range_valid == 1, !is.na(up)) |>
  transmute(form = form_name, subtype = form_subtype, office = office_code,
            name = oname(office_code), lo, up) |>
  arrange(form, up)

# --- what moved in the most recent release
last_rel <- max(evts$event_date)
release <- evts |> filter(event_date == last_rel) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(du))) |> slice_head(n = 40) |>
  transmute(form = form_name, office = oname(office_code), subtype = form_subtype,
            pu = round(pu, 1), nu = round(nu, 1), du = round(du, 1), direction)

# --- freshness: how old is the number you are shown
# across the whole archive, not the latest day: the newest snapshot lands right
# after a release, so every figure looks one day old and the typical staleness
# a reader actually meets disappears
stale_dist <- snap |> filter(!is.na(age_days)) |>
  mutate(wk = pmin(10L, as.integer(age_days %/% 7))) |>
  count(wk, name = "n") |> arrange(wk) |>
  mutate(band = ifelse(wk == 10, "70+", paste0(wk * 7, " to ", wk * 7 + 6)),
         pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
stale_month <- snap |> filter(!is.na(age_days)) |>
  mutate(ym = format(snapshot_date, "%Y-%m")) |>
  group_by(ym) |> summarise(mean_age = round(mean(age_days), 1),
                            max_age = round(max(age_days)), .groups = "drop") |> arrange(ym)

# --- the two published numbers against each other, one point per live key
agree <- cur |> filter(range_valid == 1, !is.na(up), !is.na(implied_up)) |>
  transmute(form = form_name, office = oname(office_code), subtype = form_subtype,
            published = round(up, 2), implied = round(implied_up, 2),
            gap = round(implied_up - up, 2))

# --- months added and removed by revision, per year
drift <- evts |> mutate(yr = format(event_date, "%Y")) |>
  group_by(yr) |>
  summarise(revisions = n(),
            added   = round(sum(du[du > 0])),
            removed = round(sum(du[du < 0])),
            net     = round(sum(du)), .groups = "drop") |> arrange(yr)

# --- form by year levels, for the matrix
heat <- snap |> filter(range_valid == 1, !is.na(up)) |>
  mutate(yr = format(snapshot_date, "%Y")) |>
  group_by(form_name, yr) |>
  summarise(mu = round(mean(up), 1),
            ml = round(mean(lo, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(ml = ifelse(is.finite(ml), ml, NA_real_),
         sp = ifelse(is.na(ml), NA_real_, round(mu - ml, 1))) |>
  group_by(form_name) |> filter(sum(n) > 2000) |> ungroup()

# --- which way the two bounds moved together
patterns <- evts |> filter(!is.na(dl)) |>
  mutate(pattern = case_when(
    dl == 0 & du != 0 ~ "upper only",
    du == 0 & dl != 0 ~ "lower only",
    dl * du > 0       ~ "same direction",
    dl * du < 0       ~ "opposite directions",
    TRUE              ~ "both unchanged")) |>
  count(pattern, name = "n") |> arrange(desc(n))

# --- the precision USCIS actually publishes at
prec <- snap |> filter(!is.na(up)) |>
  mutate(frac = round(up - floor(up), 2),
         bucket = ifelse(frac %in% c(0, 0.5), sprintf("%.1f", frac), "other")) |>
  count(bucket, name = "n") |> arrange(desc(n))

# --- is a rise broad or concentrated: per form, and per office within a form
yr_form <- snap |> filter(range_valid == 1, !is.na(up)) |>
  mutate(yr = format(snapshot_date, "%Y")) |>
  group_by(form_name, yr) |> summarise(mu = mean(up), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
Y1 <- sort(unique(yr_form$yr)); Y_PREV <- Y1[length(Y1) - 1]; Y_NOW <- Y1[length(Y1)]
formchg <- yr_form |> filter(yr %in% c(Y_PREV, Y_NOW), n > 500) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = yr, values_from = c(mu, n)) |>
  transmute(form = form_name,
            prev = round(.data[[paste0("mu_", Y_PREV)]], 1),
            now  = round(.data[[paste0("mu_", Y_NOW)]], 1)) |>
  filter(!is.na(prev), !is.na(now)) |>
  mutate(chg = round(now - prev, 2)) |> arrange(desc(chg))

yr_off <- OFFICE_ONLY(snap) |> filter(range_valid == 1, !is.na(up),
                                      form_name %in% OFFICE_FORMS) |>
  mutate(yr = format(snapshot_date, "%Y")) |>
  group_by(form_name, office_code, yr) |> summarise(mu = mean(up), .groups = "drop")
offchg <- yr_off |> filter(yr %in% c(Y_PREV, Y_NOW)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = yr, values_from = mu) |>
  filter(!is.na(.data[[Y_PREV]]), !is.na(.data[[Y_NOW]])) |>
  group_by(form_name) |>
  summarise(offices = n(),
            rose = sum(.data[[Y_NOW]] > .data[[Y_PREV]]),
            fell = sum(.data[[Y_NOW]] < .data[[Y_PREV]]), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(pct_rose = round(100 * rose / offices, 1)) |> arrange(desc(pct_rose))

# figures the copy quotes, so the wording follows the data
S2 <- list(
  age_mean  = round(mean(snap$age_days, na.rm = TRUE)),
  age_max   = round(max(snap$age_days, na.rm = TRUE)),
  age_now   = round(mean(cur$age_days, na.rm = TRUE)),
  rel_date  = format(last_rel),
  rel_n     = sum(evts$event_date == last_rel),
  rel_worse = sum(evts$event_date == last_rel & evts$direction == "worsened"),
  rel_better= sum(evts$event_date == last_rel & evts$direction == "improved"),
  agree_pct = round(100 * mean(abs(agree$gap) <= 1), 1),
  agree_gap = round(mean(agree$gap), 2),
  gap_side  = sum(agree$gap < -1),
  prev_yr   = Y_PREV, now_yr = Y_NOW,
  rose_n    = sum(formchg$chg > 0), form_n = nrow(formchg),
  cadence   = round(mean(diff(sort(unique(evts$event_date))))),
  prec_half = round(100 * sum(prec$n[prec$bucket %in% c("0.0","0.5")]) / sum(prec$n), 1))

note2 <- data.frame(
  spread = "Every office publishing this form at the latest snapshot, ordered by upper bound. The gap between the fastest and slowest office is the part of the wait that depends only on where a case was filed.",
  release = sprintf(paste("The release of %s carried %s revisions: %s worsened against %s",
                          "improved. Revisions land roughly every %s days."),
                    S2$rel_date, fmt(S2$rel_n), fmt(S2$rel_worse), fmt(S2$rel_better), S2$cadence),
  stale = sprintf(paste("USCIS stamps every estimate with the date it computed it, then serves",
                        "it unchanged until the next cycle, so what you read is always older",
                        "than it looks. Bars count observations by how old the figure already",
                        "was when collected. The mean is %s days, the oldest %s. Age barely",
                        "varies by form, because the publication cycle sets it, not the form."),
                  S2$age_mean, S2$age_max),
  stale_trend = "Mean and maximum age of the published estimate, by month of collection.",
  agree = sprintf(paste("Each dot is one key published today. Across is the upper bound USCIS",
                        "publishes for it; up is the wait implied by the date it says a case must",
                        "predate before you may call. The dashed line is where the two match.",
                        "%s of %s keys sit within a month of it, the inquiry date running %s days",
                        "short of the bound, which is about the gap that rounding every estimate",
                        "to the nearest half month produces."),
                  fmt(sum(abs(agree$gap) <= 1)), fmt(nrow(agree)),
                  round(abs(S2$agree_gap) * 30.44)),
  drift = "Months added and removed by revision each year, with the net marked. Positive means the published waits grew over the year.",
  heat = "Mean upper bound in months, by form and year. Reading down a column shows whether that form recovered or deteriorated. Darker is a longer wait, on a scale set by the highest and lowest cell shown.",
  patterns = "How the two bounds moved when a revision touched them. Opposite directions means the span widened or narrowed rather than shifting.",
  prec = sprintf(paste("USCIS reports its two bounds to the half month and nothing finer: %s%%",
                       "of values land exactly on .0 or .5, so a bound moving less than half a",
                       "month has moved less than the agency reports. The dates it publishes are",
                       "exact, so the day counts elsewhere are unaffected."), S2$prec_half),
  formchg = sprintf(paste("Change in the mean upper bound from %s to %s. %s of %s forms with",
                          "enough coverage to compare rose."),
                    Y_PREV, Y_NOW, S2$rose_n, S2$form_n),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# --- when a key stopped (or resumed) being published, for marking the series
discev <- disc |>
  filter(event_type %in% c("disappeared", "retracted")) |>
  transmute(form = form_name, subtype = form_subtype, office = office_code,
            ym = format(event_date, "%Y-%m"), date = format(event_date),
            kind = ifelse(event_type == "retracted", "returned", "stopped"),
            status)

# --- the collection record, and the gaps in it. A break in the line is not just
#     absence: a change can land inside one, and then it cannot be dated to a day.
covrows <- cov |>
  transmute(d = format(date), n = ifelse(absent == 1, NA_real_, n_rows),
            absent = as.integer(absent))

.r <- rle(cov$absent == 1)
.i <- cumsum(c(0, utils::head(.r$lengths, -1))) + 1
gaps <- data.frame(start = cov$date[.i], len = .r$lengths, is_gap = .r$values,
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  filter(is_gap) |>
  mutate(end = start + len - 1) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(before = { v <- cov$n_rows[cov$date < start & cov$absent == 0]
                    if (length(v)) utils::tail(v, 1) else NA_real_ },
         after  = { v <- cov$n_rows[cov$date > end & cov$absent == 0]
                    if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_real_ },
         events = sum(disc$event_date == (end + 1))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(delta = after - before,
         start = format(start), end = format(end)) |>
  select(start, end, len, before, after, delta, events) |>
  arrange(desc(len))

GAP_LABEL_MIN <- 3L   # shorter runs are a single missing day, not a visible break
big_gap <- gaps[gaps$len >= GAP_LABEL_MIN, ]

note4 <- data.frame(
  cover = sprintf(paste("Keys published on each day the feed was reachable. Shaded columns are",
                        "the %s days with no snapshot, in %s runs. The widest is %s days, across",
                        "which the count fell from %s to %s. Hover one for what changed inside."),
                  S$absent, nrow(gaps), gaps$len[1],
                  fmt(gaps$before[1]), fmt(gaps$after[1])),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# --- how each published figure becomes a number on this dashboard. Built as a
#     table because the point is the rule, not the prose around it.
n_norm  <- sum(!is.na(snap$up))
dirn    <- table(factor(evts$direction, c("improved","worsened","unchanged")))
disc_n  <- table(factor(disc$status, c("confirmed","provisional","retracted")))
n_off   <- length(unique(spread$office))

DERIV_R <- data.frame(
  Quantity = c(
    "Bound in months", "Missing bound", "Range validity", "Revision event",
    "Revision direction", "Inquiry-date movement", "Withdrawal", "Collection gap",
    "Retired service centres", "Age of the estimate", "Office spread", "Break in a line"),
  Input = c(
    "the bound and its unit string",
    "the same fields, nothing usable published",

    "consecutive snapshots of a key",

    "inquiry date day to day",
    "a key vanishing",
    "the coverage table",
    "office code against its successor",
    "snapshot date minus publication date",
    "latest snapshot, field offices",
    "a run of days with no snapshot"),
  Rule = c(
    "weeks x 7 / 30.44, days / 30.44, months left alone",
    "NA with a reason code, never 0",
    "invalid when the lower exceeds the upper, checked after normalising",
    "dated to the first day seen, bounded by the previous snapshot",
    "judged on the upper bound alone",
    "one day of advance expected per elapsed day",
    "confirmed only after two present snapshots both lack the key",
    "recorded absent, never counted as a withdrawal",

    "no rounding; the age on the day it was collected",
    "pseudo office codes excluded",
    "drawn as a hole and shaded, never bridged; a change inside one carries the date collection resumed, not the date it happened"),
  Result = c(
    sprintf("%s values normalised", fmt(n_norm)),
    sprintf("%s rows carry a reason", fmt(S$rescued)),
    sprintf("%s observations across %s keys fail", fmt(S$invalid), S$invalid_keys),
    sprintf("%s events, landing every %s days", fmt(nrow(evts)), S2$cadence),
    sprintf("%s worsened, %s improved, %s unchanged",
            fmt(dirn[["worsened"]]), fmt(dirn[["improved"]]), fmt(dirn[["unchanged"]])),
    sprintf("%s backward moves across %s keys", fmt(S$bw_n), fmt(S$bw_keys)),
    sprintf("%s confirmed, %s provisional, %s retracted",
            fmt(disc_n[["confirmed"]]), fmt(disc_n[["provisional"]]), fmt(disc_n[["retracted"]])),
    sprintf("%s days absent, longest run %s", S$absent, S$absent_run),
    if (is.na(S$ret_last)) "none in this span"
      else sprintf("%s centres, last seen %s", S$ret_n, S$ret_last),
    sprintf("mean %s days, oldest %s", S2$age_mean, S2$age_max),
    sprintf("%s offices compared", n_off),
    sprintf("%s days in %s runs, widest %s days", S$absent, nrow(gaps), gaps$len[1])),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

THRESH_R <- data.frame(
  Rule = c("Percentile basis", "Published precision", "Withdrawal confirmation",
           "Backslide ranking floor", "Forms with a per-office dimension",
           "Office codes treated as directorates", "Comparison year pair",
           "Freeze gate on the monthly grain"),
  Value = c("USCIS 80% completion method; the bounds are percentile positions, never averaged",
            sprintf("half a month, %s%% of values land on .0 or .5", S2$prec_half),
            "two consecutive snapshots that exist and both lack the key",
            sprintf("%s recorded backslides before a form is ranked on severity", BW_FLOOR),
            paste(OFFICE_FORMS, collapse = ", "),
            paste(PSEUDO, collapse = ", "),
            sprintf("%s against %s", S2$prev_yr, S2$now_yr),
            "intra-cycle edits are flagged rather than merged into the next revision"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# --- the shape of what USCIS publishes today: every live key, banded by wait
BAND_W <- 6L; BAND_TOP <- 10L
livek <- cur |> filter(range_valid == 1, !is.na(up)) |>
  mutate(b = pmin(BAND_TOP, as.integer(up %/% BAND_W)))
waitband <- livek |> group_by(b) |>
  summarise(keys = n(), forms = n_distinct(form_name),
            top = paste(utils::head(names(sort(table(form_name), decreasing = TRUE)), 3),
                        collapse = ", "),
            fastest = sprintf("%s at %s, %s mo",
                              form_name[which.min(up)], oname(office_code[which.min(up)]),
                              round(min(up), 1)),
            slowest = sprintf("%s at %s, %s mo",
                              form_name[which.max(up)], oname(office_code[which.max(up)]),
                              round(max(up), 1)),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(band = ifelse(b == BAND_TOP, paste0(BAND_TOP * BAND_W, "+"),
                       paste0(b * BAND_W, " to ", b * BAND_W + BAND_W - 1)),
         pct = round(100 * keys / sum(keys), 1)) |>
  arrange(b)

# --- headline figures, about the waits rather than about our collection
prev_mean <- mean(snap$up[format(snap$snapshot_date, "%Y") == S2$prev_yr &
                          snap$range_valid == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
now_mean  <- mean(snap$up[format(snap$snapshot_date, "%Y") == S2$now_yr &
                          snap$range_valid == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
S3 <- list(
  med_wait  = round(median(livek$up), 1),
  max_wait  = round(max(livek$up)),
  max_where = sprintf("%s at %s", livek$form_name[which.max(livek$up)],
                      oname(livek$office_code[which.max(livek$up)])),
  live_keys = nrow(livek),
  offices   = n_distinct(livek$office_code[nchar(livek$office_code) == 3 &
                                           !livek$office_code %in% PSEUDO]),
  yoy       = round(now_mean - prev_mean, 1))

note3 <- data.frame(
  waits = sprintf(paste("Every form, office and subtype USCIS is publishing today, %s in all,",
                        "grouped by the upper bound of its estimate. Half sit at or below %s",
                        "months; the tail runs to %s months at %s. Hover a bar for the forms",
                        "inside it."),
                  fmt(nrow(livek)), S3$med_wait, S3$max_wait, S3$max_where),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Built from the live schema rather than written out by hand, so a column added
# upstream shows up here instead of silently going undocumented.
CB_DESC <- c(
  snapshot_date        = "Day the row was collected. One row per key per day the feed was reachable.",
  form_name            = "USCIS form number, for example I-485.",

  office_code_stitched = "Office code after the retired service centres are mapped onto their successors.",
  form_subtype         = "Sub category within a form. A form can publish several, each with its own bounds.",
  publication_date     = "Date USCIS says it computed the estimate. Earlier than snapshot_date by the age of the figure.",
  service_request_date = "Date a case must predate before USCIS will accept an inquiry about it.",
  range_lower          = "Lower bound exactly as published, in whatever unit the page used.",
  range_upper          = "Upper bound exactly as published, in whatever unit the page used.",
  range_lower_unit     = "Unit string as published. Mostly Months, occasionally Weeks, and sometimes scraped link text.",
  range_upper_unit     = "Unit string as published, same caveats as the lower unit.",
  range_lower_months   = "Lower bound normalised to months. NA with a reason when nothing usable was published.",
  range_upper_months   = "Upper bound normalised to months. NA with a reason when nothing usable was published.",
  range_lower_reason   = "Why the normalised lower bound is missing, when it is. Never blank in place of a zero.",
  range_upper_reason   = "Why the normalised upper bound is missing, when it is.",
  range_valid          = "1 when the normalised lower bound does not exceed the upper. Checked after normalisation.",
  subtype_info_en      = "Plain English description of what the subtype covers.",
  subtype_info_es      = "The same description in Spanish.",
  subtype_note_en      = "Footnote USCIS attaches to the subtype.",
  subtype_note_es      = "The subtype footnote in Spanish.",
  form_note_en         = "Footnote USCIS attaches to the whole form.",
  form_note_es         = "The form footnote in Spanish.",
  event_date           = "Day a change was first observed. Bounded by the snapshot before it.",
  prev_lower_months    = "Lower bound before the revision, in months.",
  new_lower_months     = "Lower bound after the revision, in months.",
  prev_upper_months    = "Upper bound before the revision, in months.",
  new_upper_months     = "Upper bound after the revision, in months.",
  delta_lower_months   = "New lower bound minus the previous one. Positive means a longer wait.",
  delta_upper_months   = "New upper bound minus the previous one. Positive means a longer wait.",
  direction            = "improved, worsened or unchanged, judged on the upper bound.",
  intra_cycle_edit     = "1 when the value changed while USCIS's own publication date did not.",
  first_seen           = "First day this published value was observed.",
  last_seen            = "Last day this published value was observed.",
  first_publication_date = "Earliest publication date USCIS stamped on this value.",
  last_publication_date  = "Latest publication date USCIS stamped on this value.",
  n_observations       = "Number of daily snapshots in which this value appeared.",
  n_publication_cycles = "Number of distinct publication dates this value spanned.",
  event_type           = "appeared, disappeared or retracted.",
  status               = "confirmed once two consecutive present snapshots lack the key, provisional before that.",
  date_uncertainty_days = "Width of the window the event could have fallen in, given collection gaps.",
  successor_key        = "Key the row was stitched onto, when a disappearance was a rename rather than a withdrawal.",
  expected_delta_days  = "Days the inquiry date should have moved given the gap between snapshots, normally one per elapsed day.",
  observed_delta_days  = "Days the inquiry date actually moved. Negative means it moved backwards.",
  delta_excess_days    = "Observed movement minus expected. Zero is an inquiry date keeping pace with the calendar.",
  anomaly_class        = "How the inquiry date moved: normal, post_gap after a collection gap, leap when it jumped further than the calendar, stalled when it failed to advance, backward, or first_observation.",
  date                 = "Calendar day of the coverage record.",
  absent               = "1 when no snapshot exists for the day.",

CB_ABOUT_TXT <- c(
  pt_snapshots = "One row per form, office, subtype and day. This is the spine of the panel: every other table is derived from it. It records what USCIS published on each day it was reachable, including the rows where it published nothing usable.",
  pt_events    = "One row per observed change to a published bound. An event is dated to the day the change was first seen, which is bounded by the previous snapshot rather than known exactly.",
  pt_cycles    = "One row per run of identical published values. Useful for asking how long a figure stood and how many publication cycles it survived.",
  inquiry_events = "One row per movement of the case inquiry date. Normally it advances a day per day; this table exists to record when it does not.",
  disclosure_events = "One row per key appearing, disappearing or being retracted. A key is only called withdrawn once two consecutive snapshots that exist both lack it.",
  coverage     = "One row per calendar day in the span, marking whether a snapshot exists. Absence is recorded so a collection gap is never read as the agency withdrawing everything."
)

cb_con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), PANEL)
CB_TBLS <- c("pt_snapshots","pt_events","pt_cycles","inquiry_events",
             "disclosure_events","coverage")
cb_list <- lapply(CB_TBLS, function(tb) {
  info <- dbGetQuery(cb_con, sprintf("PRAGMA table_info(%s)", tb))
  smp  <- dbGetQuery(cb_con, sprintf("SELECT * FROM %s LIMIT 200", tb))
  n    <- dbGetQuery(cb_con, sprintf("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM %s", tb))$n
  nas  <- vapply(info$name, function(v) {
    k <- dbGetQuery(cb_con, sprintf("SELECT SUM(%s IS NULL) k FROM %s", v, tb))$k
    round(100 * (if (is.na(k)) 0 else k) / max(n, 1), 1)
  }, numeric(1))
  ex <- vapply(info$name, function(v) {
    val <- smp[[v]][!is.na(smp[[v]])][1]
    if (length(val) == 0 || is.na(val)) return("never populated")
    if (v %in% c("snapshot_date","event_date","date","publication_date",
                 "service_request_date","first_seen","last_seen",
                 "first_publication_date","last_publication_date"))
      return(format(onx(as.numeric(val))))
    out <- as.character(val)
    if (nchar(out) > 34) paste0(substr(out, 1, 34), "…") else out
  }, character(1))
  data.frame(tbl = tb, name = info$name, type = info$type,
             desc = ifelse(is.na(CB_DESC[info$name]),
                           "Not yet documented.", unname(CB_DESC[info$name])),
             example = unname(ex), pct_na = unname(nas), n_rows = n,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
codebook <- do.call(rbind, cb_list)
cb_rowcounts <- as.list(setNames(vapply(cb_list, function(d) d$n_rows[1], numeric(1)), CB_TBLS))
cb_about <- as.list(CB_ABOUT_TXT[CB_TBLS])

# three real rows per table, columns trimmed so the card stays readable
cb_sample <- setNames(lapply(CB_TBLS, function(tb) {
  d <- dbGetQuery(cb_con, sprintf("SELECT * FROM %s LIMIT 3", tb))
  keep <- head(names(d), 9)
  d <- d[keep]
  for (v in names(d)) {
    if (v %in% c("snapshot_date","event_date","date","publication_date",
                 "service_request_date","first_seen","last_seen"))
      d[[v]] <- format(onx(as.numeric(d[[v]])))
    d[[v]] <- ifelse(is.na(d[[v]]), NA, substr(as.character(d[[v]]), 1, 26))
  }
  list(cols = names(d), rows = lapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) unname(as.list(d[i, ]))))
}), CB_TBLS)
dbDisconnect(cb_con)

ojs_define(OFF = off, SERIES = series, FORMS = form_index, DESC = desc,
           OFFNAMES = offname_tbl, BWM = bwm, BWF = bwf, BWNOTE = bwnote,
           DYEAR = dyear, DFORM = dform, DISCNOTE = discnote,
           SPREAD = spread, RELEASE = release, STALED = stale_dist, STALEM = stale_month,
           AGREE = agree, DRIFT = drift, HEAT = heat, PATTERNS = patterns, PREC = prec,
           FORMCHG = formchg, OFFCHG = offchg, NOTE2 = note2,
           WAITBAND = waitband, NOTE3 = note3,
           COV = covrows, GAPS = gaps, BIGGAP = big_gap, NOTE4 = note4,
           DISCEV = discev,
           CB = codebook, CB_TABLES = CB_TBLS, CB_ROWS = cb_rowcounts,
           CB_ABOUT = cb_about, CB_SAMPLE = cb_sample)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
//| label: ojs-helpers

niceTop = (v) => {
  if (!isFinite(v) || v <= 0) return 10;
  const p = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(v)));
  return Math.ceil(v / (p / 2)) * (p / 2);
}

d3g = (rows, keyfn) => {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const r of rows) { const k = keyfn(r); if (!m.has(k)) m.set(k, []); m.get(k).push(r); }
  return m;
}

SERIES_COLS = ["#0E7FA8","#B02A50","#5F8A1E","#7C52A8","#B5651D","#2F6F62",
               "#8A3B8F","#4A6FA5","#9A7B10","#496B2E"]

OFFICE_NAME_MAP = new Map(OFFNAMES.code.map((c, i) => [c, OFFNAMES.name[i]]))
officeName = (c) => OFFICE_NAME_MAP.get(c) ?? c

}))

}))
```
