```{ojs}
nf = (v) => v == null ? "not recorded" : v.toLocaleString("en-US")

plural = (v, w) => v == null ? "not recorded" : nf(v) + " " + w + (v === 1 ? "" : "s")

// Keeps the readout inside its card: it flips to the cursor's left only when
// there is genuinely no room on the right, measured rather than guessed.
// Quarto's OJS `width` is the page width, not the cell's, so a chart sized from
// it gets scaled down by the browser and every label shrinks with it. This
// measures the card the chart actually lands in and draws at 1:1, redrawing on
// resize. The second pass exists because the note's height is only knowable
// once it has been laid out at this width.
fitted = function (draw, opts = {}) {
  const { fallbackRatio = 0.55, minHeight = 92 } = opts;
  // The host stretches to fill the card, so its own box IS the space available:
  // no arithmetic over padding, sibling controls or the card's own height, all
  // of which read wrong while the dashboard is still laying itself out.
  const host = htl.html`<div style="width:100%;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;
    align-self:stretch;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start"></div>`;
  let lastW = 0, lastH = -1;
  const paint = () => {
    const w = Math.round(host.clientWidth);
    const avail = Math.round(host.clientHeight);
    if (!w) return;
    if (w === lastW && avail === lastH) return;
    lastW = w; lastH = avail;
    if (!avail) { host.replaceChildren(draw(w, Math.round(w * fallbackRatio))); return; }

    const measure = () => {
      const n = host.querySelector(".chart-note");
      // scrollHeight, not the rect: a note squeezed by the fill container
      // reports its clipped height, which would under-reserve and clip it again
      return n ? Math.max(n.scrollHeight, n.getBoundingClientRect().height) + 10 : 0;
    };
    let h = Math.max(minHeight, avail - measure());
    host.replaceChildren(draw(w, h));
    // the first pass draws at a guessed height, which can wrap the note
    // differently; once it is laid out for real, correct the reserve once
    const h2 = Math.max(minHeight, avail - measure());
    if (Math.abs(h2 - h) > 6) host.replaceChildren(draw(w, h2));
  };
  new ResizeObserver(paint).observe(host);
  requestAnimationFrame(paint);
  [60, 200, 600].forEach(t => setTimeout(paint, t));
  return host;
}

placeTip = function (tip, ev, box) {
  const x = ev.clientX - box.left, y = ev.clientY - box.top;
  const w = tip.offsetWidth || 300, h = tip.offsetHeight || 90;
  tip.style.left = (x + 18 + w <= box.width ? x + 18
                    : Math.max(4, x - 18 - w)) + "px";
  tip.style.top = Math.max(4, Math.min(box.height - h - 4, y - 30)) + "px";
}

// A daily series with the gaps drawn as gaps, and each run of missing days
// shaded so a change that landed inside one is not read as a change on the day
// collection resumed.
gapChart = function (rows, gaps, opts = {}) {
  const { width = 1320, height = 300, note = "", yUnit = "" } = opts;
  if (!rows.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">Nothing recorded.</div>`;

  const W = width, H = height, M = { t: 26, r: 22, b: 34, l: 60 };
  const idx = new Map(rows.map((r, i) => [r.d, i]));
  const X = i => M.l + (i / (rows.length - 1)) * (W - M.l - M.r);
  const vals = rows.map(r => r.n).filter(v => v != null);
  const yLo = Math.floor(Math.min(...vals) / 50) * 50;
  const yTop = niceTop(Math.max(...vals));
  const Y = v => H - M.b - ((v - yLo) / (yTop - yLo)) * (H - M.t - M.b);
  const ticks = [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].map(f => Math.round(yLo + (yTop - yLo) * f));

  // one path per unbroken run, so a missing day leaves a real hole in the line
  const paths = [];
  let d = "", open = false;
  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    if (r.n == null) { if (open) { paths.push(d); d = ""; open = false; } return; }
    const x = X(i), y = Y(r.n);
    d += open ? `H${x}V${y}` : `M${x} ${y}`;
    open = true;
  });
  if (open) paths.push(d);

  const tipEl = htl.html`<div class="ctip"></div>`;
  const bands = gaps.map(g => {
    const a = idx.get(g.start), b2 = idx.get(g.end);
    if (a == null || b2 == null) return null;
    const w0 = Math.max(7, X(b2) - X(a));
    const cx = X(a) + w0 / 2;
    return htl.svg`<g style="cursor:help"
      onmouseenter=${ev => showGap(ev, g)} onmousemove=${ev => showGap(ev, g)}
      onmouseleave=${() => { tipEl.style.opacity = 0; }}>
      <rect x=${X(a)} y=${M.t} width=${w0} height=${H - M.t - M.b}
        class="sr1" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".15"/>
      <line x1=${cx} x2=${cx} y1=${M.t} y2=${H - M.b} class="sr1" stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 3" opacity=".65"/>
      <text x=${cx} y=${M.t - 8} text-anchor="middle" class="ser sr1"
        fill="currentColor">${g.len} d</text>
    </g>`;
  }).filter(Boolean);

  const years = rows.map((r, i) => ({ r, i })).filter(({ r }) => r.d.endsWith("-01-01"));

  const svg = htl.svg`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="ojs-chart">
    ${ticks.map(t => htl.svg`<g>
      <line x1=${M.l} x2=${W - M.r} y1=${Y(t)} y2=${Y(t)} class="grid"/>
      <text x=${M.l - 8} y=${Y(t) + 4} text-anchor="end" class="ax">${t}${yUnit}</text></g>`)}
    ${years.map(({ r, i }) => htl.svg`<text x=${X(i)} y=${H - 12} text-anchor="middle"
      class="ax">${r.d.slice(0, 4)}</text>`)}
    ${bands}
    ${paths.map(pd => htl.svg`<path d=${pd} fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-width="1.8" class="sr0"/>`)}
  </svg>`;

  function showGap(ev, g) {
    const row = (k, v) => `<div class="ct-r"><span class="ct-k">${k}</span>` +
                          `<span class="ct-v">${v}</span></div>`;
    tipEl.innerHTML = `<div class="ct-h">No snapshots, ${g.start} to ${g.end}</div>` +
      row("days missing", plural(g.len, "day")) +
      row("keys before", nf(g.before)) +
      row("keys after", nf(g.after)) +
      row("change across the gap",
          (g.delta > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(g.delta) + " keys") +
      row("changes forced to the reopen day", nf(g.events)) +
      `<div class="ct-more">Nothing can be dated inside a gap: the first day a change ` +
      `can be seen is the day collection resumed, so it carries that date instead.</div>`;
    tipEl.style.opacity = 1;
    placeTip(tipEl, ev, svg.getBoundingClientRect());
  }

  return htl.html`<div class="chart-wrap">${svg}${tipEl}${
    note ? htl.html`<div class="chart-note">${note}</div>` : null}</div>`;
}

// Vertical columns, one per row. value/label/detail keep it independent of any
// one dataset, and every slot is drawn so gaps stay visible as gaps.
colChart = function (rows, opts = {}) {
  const { width = 1320, height = 330, note = "", cls = "sr1", yLabel = "",
          value = r => r.v, label = () => null, detail = () => [],
          emptyAt = null } = opts;
  if (!rows.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">Nothing recorded.</div>`;

  const W = width, H = height, M = { t: 28, r: 22, b: 34, l: 66 };
  const band = (W - M.l - M.r) / rows.length;
  const bw = Math.max(3, band * 0.74);
  const X = i => M.l + band * i + (band - bw) / 2;
  const yTop = niceTop(Math.max(...rows.map(value)));
  const Y = v => H - M.b - (v / yTop) * (H - M.t - M.b);
  const ticks = [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].map(f => Math.round(yTop * f));

  const bars = rows.map((r, i) => htl.svg`<rect x=${X(i)} y=${Y(value(r))} width=${bw}
      height=${Math.max(0, H - M.b - Y(value(r)))} class="${cls}" fill="currentColor"
      fill-opacity=".82"/>`);
  const tipEl = htl.html`<div class="ctip"></div>`;

  const svg = htl.svg`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="ojs-chart">
    ${ticks.map(t => htl.svg`<g>
      <line x1=${M.l} x2=${W - M.r} y1=${Y(t)} y2=${Y(t)} class="grid"/>
      <text x=${M.l - 8} y=${Y(t) + 4} text-anchor="end" class="ax">${t}</text></g>`)}
    <text x="2" y="11" class="axl">${yLabel}</text>
    ${rows.map((r, i) => { const l = label(r); return l == null ? null
      : htl.svg`<text x=${X(i) + bw / 2} y=${H - 12} text-anchor="middle"
                 class="ax">${l}</text>`; })}
    ${bars}
  </svg>`;

  const hit = htl.svg`<rect x=${M.l} y=${M.t} width=${W - M.l - M.r}
                       height=${H - M.t - M.b} fill="transparent"/>`;
  svg.append(hit);

  hit.onmousemove = ev => {
    const box = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const px = (ev.clientX - box.left) / box.width * W;
    const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(rows.length - 1, Math.floor((px - M.l) / band)));
    const r = rows[i];
    bars.forEach((b2, j) => b2.setAttribute("fill-opacity", j === i ? 1 : .28));
    const head = `<div class="ct-h">${label(r) ?? r.band ?? r.ym ?? ""}</div>`;
    tipEl.innerHTML = head + (emptyAt && value(r) === 0
      ? `<div class="ct-more">${emptyAt}</div>`
      : detail(r).map(([k, v]) => `<div class="ct-r"><span class="ct-k">${k}</span>` +
          `<span class="ct-v">${v}</span></div>`).join(""));
    tipEl.style.opacity = 1;
    placeTip(tipEl, ev, box);
  };
  hit.onmouseleave = () => {
    bars.forEach(b2 => b2.setAttribute("fill-opacity", .82));
    tipEl.style.opacity = 0;
  };

  return htl.html`<div class="chart-wrap">${svg}${tipEl}${
    note ? htl.html`<div class="chart-note">${note}</div>` : null}</div>`;
}

// --- row builders for the new analyses -------------------------------------
cols2rows = (obj) => {
  const keys = Object.keys(obj);
  const n = obj[keys[0]].length;
  return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) =>
    Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k => [k, obj[k][i]])));
}

SPREADROWS = cols2rows(SPREAD)
RELROWS    = cols2rows(RELEASE)
STALEDROWS = cols2rows(STALED)
STALEMROWS = cols2rows(STALEM)
AGREEROWS  = cols2rows(AGREE)
DRIFTROWS  = cols2rows(DRIFT)
HEATROWS   = cols2rows(HEAT)
PATROWS    = cols2rows(PATTERNS)
PRECROWS   = cols2rows(PREC)
FORMCHGROWS = cols2rows(FORMCHG)
OFFCHGROWS  = cols2rows(OFFCHG)
WAITROWS    = cols2rows(WAITBAND)
COVROWS     = cols2rows(COV)
DISCEVROWS  = cols2rows(DISCEV)
GAPROWS     = cols2rows(BIGGAP)
CBROWS      = cols2rows(CB)

// Every office on one axis, so the spread that depends purely on where a case
// was filed is visible as a distance rather than inferred from a table.
stripChart = function (rows, opts = {}) {
  const { width = 1320, height = 300, note = "", empty = "Nothing published for this selection." } = opts;
  if (!rows.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">${empty}</div>`;

  const W = width, H = height, M = { t: 40, r: 26, b: 46, l: 26 };
  const vals = rows.flatMap(r => [r.lo, r.up]).filter(v => v != null);
  const hi = niceTop(Math.max(...vals));
  const X = v => M.l + (v / hi) * (W - M.l - M.r);
  const ticks = [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].map(f => Math.round(hi * f));
  const laneU = M.t + (H - M.t - M.b) * 0.32;
  const laneL = M.t + (H - M.t - M.b) * 0.72;

  const quant = (arr, q) => {
    const a = arr.slice().sort((x, y) => x - y);
    return a[Math.min(a.length - 1, Math.floor(q * (a.length - 1)))];
  };
  const ups = rows.map(r => r.up).filter(v => v != null);
  const q1 = quant(ups, .25), med = quant(ups, .5), q3 = quant(ups, .75);

  // a deterministic offset per index keeps overlapping offices readable
  const jitter = i => ((i * 37) % 11 - 5) * 2.1;
  const tipEl = htl.html`<div class="ctip"></div>`;
  const dotsU = rows.map((r, i) => r.up == null ? null :
    htl.svg`<circle cx=${X(r.up)} cy=${laneU + jitter(i)} r="4.6" class="pt sr1"
      fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".62"
      onmouseenter=${ev => show(ev, r)} onmousemove=${ev => show(ev, r)} />`);
  const dotsL = rows.map((r, i) => r.lo == null ? null :
    htl.svg`<circle cx=${X(r.lo)} cy=${laneL + jitter(i)} r="4.6" class="pt sr0"
      fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".62"
      onmouseenter=${ev => show(ev, r)} onmousemove=${ev => show(ev, r)} />`);

  const svg = htl.svg`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="ojs-chart">
    ${ticks.map(t => htl.svg`<g>
      <line x1=${X(t)} x2=${X(t)} y1=${M.t - 16} y2=${H - M.b} class="grid"/>
      <text x=${X(t)} y=${H - M.b + 18} text-anchor="middle" class="ax">${t} mo</text></g>`)}
    <rect x=${X(q1)} y=${M.t - 14} width=${Math.max(1, X(q3) - X(q1))}
      height=${H - M.b - M.t + 14} class="sr1" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".07"/>
    <line x1=${X(med)} x2=${X(med)} y1=${M.t - 14} y2=${H - M.b} class="rule"
      stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
    <text x=${X(med)} y=${M.t - 20} text-anchor="middle" class="ser sr1"
      fill="currentColor">median ${med} mo</text>
    <text x=${M.l} y=${laneU - 26} class="axl">upper bound, one dot per office</text>
    <text x=${M.l} y=${laneL - 24} class="axl">lower bound</text>
    ${dotsU.filter(Boolean)}${dotsL.filter(Boolean)}
  </svg>`;

  function show(ev, r) {
    const rank = rows.filter(x => x.up != null && x.up < r.up).length + 1;
    const n = rows.filter(x => x.up != null).length;
    tipEl.innerHTML = `<div class="ct-h">${r.name} \u00b7 ${r.office}</div>` +
      `<div class="ct-r"><i class="sr1" style="background:currentColor"></i>` +
      `<span class="ct-k">upper bound</span><span class="ct-v">${r.up} mo</span></div>` +
      `<div class="ct-r"><i class="sr0" style="background:currentColor"></i>` +
      `<span class="ct-k">lower bound</span><span class="ct-v">${r.lo == null ? "not published" : r.lo + " mo"}</span></div>` +
      `<div class="ct-r"><span class="ct-k">rank</span>` +
      `<span class="ct-v">${rank} of ${n}, fastest first</span></div>`;
    tipEl.style.opacity = 1;
    placeTip(tipEl, ev, svg.getBoundingClientRect());
  }
  svg.onmouseleave = () => { tipEl.style.opacity = 0; };

  return htl.html`<div class="chart-wrap">${svg}${tipEl}${
    note ? htl.html`<div class="chart-note">${note}</div>` : null}</div>`;
}

// Added above the axis, removed below, net marked: the sign of a year is the
// thing being read, so it cannot be a single stacked total.
divergeChart = function (rows, opts = {}) {
  const { width = 1320, height = 300, note = "", label = r => r.k,
          up = r => r.added, down = r => r.removed, net = r => r.net,
          unit = " mo", detail = () => [] } = opts;
  if (!rows.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">Nothing recorded.</div>`;

  const W = width, H = height, M = { t: 22, r: 26, b: 34, l: 66 };
  const mag = Math.max(...rows.map(r => Math.max(Math.abs(up(r)), Math.abs(down(r)))));
  const hi = niceTop(mag);
  const mid = M.t + (H - M.t - M.b) / 2;
  const Y = v => mid - (v / hi) * ((H - M.t - M.b) / 2);
  const band = (W - M.l - M.r) / rows.length;
  const bw = Math.min(Math.max(8, band * 0.5), 62);
  const X = i => M.l + band * i + (band - bw) / 2;
  const ticks = [-1, -.5, 0, .5, 1].map(f => Math.round(hi * f));

  const bars = rows.flatMap((r, i) => [
    htl.svg`<rect x=${X(i)} y=${Y(up(r))} width=${bw} height=${Math.max(0, mid - Y(up(r)))}
      class="sr1" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".8"/>`,
    htl.svg`<rect x=${X(i)} y=${mid} width=${bw} height=${Math.max(0, Y(down(r)) - mid)}
      class="sr0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".8"/>`]);
  const tipEl = htl.html`<div class="ctip"></div>`;

  const svg = htl.svg`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="ojs-chart">
    ${ticks.map(t => htl.svg`<g>
      <line x1=${M.l} x2=${W - M.r} y1=${Y(t)} y2=${Y(t)} class="grid"/>
      <text x=${M.l - 8} y=${Y(t) + 4} text-anchor="end" class="ax">${t}</text></g>`)}
    <line x1=${M.l} x2=${W - M.r} y1=${mid} y2=${mid} class="rule"/>
    <text x="2" y="11" class="axl">months added / removed</text>
    ${bars}
    ${rows.map((r, i) => htl.svg`<text x=${X(i) + bw / 2} y=${H - 12}
      text-anchor="middle" class="ax">${label(r)}</text>`)}
    ${rows.map((r, i) => htl.svg`<g>
      <line x1=${X(i) - 4} x2=${X(i) + bw + 4} y1=${Y(net(r))} y2=${Y(net(r))}
        class="neutral" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <text x=${X(i) + bw / 2} y=${Y(net(r)) + (net(r) >= 0 ? -7 : 15)}
        text-anchor="middle" class="${"ser " + (net(r) > 0 ? "sr1" : "sr0")}"
        fill="currentColor">${net(r) > 0 ? "+" : ""}${net(r)}</text></g>`)}
  </svg>`;

  const hit = htl.svg`<rect x=${M.l} y=${M.t} width=${W - M.l - M.r}
    height=${H - M.t - M.b} fill="transparent"/>`;
  svg.append(hit);
  hit.onmousemove = ev => {
    const box = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(rows.length - 1,
      Math.floor(((ev.clientX - box.left) / box.width * W - M.l) / band)));
    bars.forEach((b2, j) => b2.setAttribute("fill-opacity",
      (j === i * 2 || j === i * 2 + 1) ? 1 : .26));
    tipEl.innerHTML = `<div class="ct-h">${label(rows[i])}</div>` +
      detail(rows[i]).map(([k, v, c]) =>
        `<div class="ct-r">${c ? `<i class="${c}" style="background:currentColor"></i>` : ""}` +
        `<span class="ct-k">${k}</span><span class="ct-v">${v}</span></div>`).join("");
    tipEl.style.opacity = 1;
    placeTip(tipEl, ev, box);
  };
  hit.onmouseleave = () => {
    bars.forEach(b2 => b2.setAttribute("fill-opacity", .8));
    tipEl.style.opacity = 0;
  };

  return htl.html`<div class="chart-wrap">${svg}${tipEl}${
    note ? htl.html`<div class="chart-note">${note}</div>` : null}</div>`;
}

// A matrix reads magnitude, so it takes the sequential ramp, not the series steps.
heatChart = function (rows, opts = {}) {
  const { width = 1320, height = 300, note = "", unit = " mo",
          row = r => r.r, col = r => r.c, value = r => r.v, detail = () => [],
          value2 = null, split = false } = opts;
  if (!rows.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">Nothing recorded.</div>`;

  const rowKeys = [...new Set(rows.map(row))];
  const colKeys = [...new Set(rows.map(col))].sort();
  const vals = rows.map(value).filter(v => v != null);
  const lo = Math.min(...vals), hi = Math.max(...vals);
  // rank within the observed range, in six steps
  const step = v => Math.min(5, Math.max(0, Math.floor(((v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * 5.999)));

  const W = width, H = height, M = { t: 26, r: 14, b: 8, l: 46 };
  const cw = (W - M.l - M.r) / colKeys.length;
  const ch = (H - M.t - M.b) / rowKeys.length;
  const at = new Map(rows.map(r => [row(r) + "|" + col(r), r]));
  const tipEl = htl.html`<div class="ctip"></div>`;

  const half = (cw - 3) / 2;
  const cells = rowKeys.flatMap((rk, i) => colKeys.flatMap((ck, j) => {
    const r = at.get(rk + "|" + ck);
    if (!r || value(r) == null) return [];
    const y = M.t + ch * i + 1, h = Math.max(1, ch - 2);
    if (!split || value2 == null || value2(r) == null)
      return [htl.svg`<rect x=${M.l + cw * j + 1} y=${y}
        width=${Math.max(1, cw - 2)} height=${h} rx="2"
        class="${"pt hc" + step(value(r))}" fill="currentColor"
        onmouseenter=${ev => show(ev, r)} onmousemove=${ev => show(ev, r)} />`];
    // left half is the lower bound, right half the upper, on one shared scale
    return [
      htl.svg`<rect x=${M.l + cw * j + 1} y=${y} width=${half} height=${h} rx="2"
        class="${"pt hc" + step(value2(r))}" fill="currentColor"
        onmouseenter=${ev => show(ev, r)} onmousemove=${ev => show(ev, r)} />`,
      htl.svg`<rect x=${M.l + cw * j + 2 + half} y=${y} width=${half} height=${h} rx="2"
        class="${"pt hc" + step(value(r))}" fill="currentColor"
        onmouseenter=${ev => show(ev, r)} onmousemove=${ev => show(ev, r)} />`];
  }));
  const labels = rowKeys.flatMap((rk, i) => colKeys.flatMap((ck, j) => {
    const r = at.get(rk + "|" + ck);
    if (!r || ch < 15 || value(r) == null) return [];
    const cy = M.t + ch * i + ch / 2 + 3.5;
    if (!split || value2 == null || value2(r) == null)
      return [htl.svg`<text x=${M.l + cw * j + cw / 2} y=${cy} text-anchor="middle"
        class="${"cellv" + (step(value(r)) >= 4 ? " on" : "")}"
        pointer-events="none">${value(r)}</text>`];
    return [
      htl.svg`<text x=${M.l + cw * j + 1 + half / 2} y=${cy} text-anchor="middle"
        class="${"cellv" + (step(value2(r)) >= 4 ? " on" : "")}"
        pointer-events="none">${value2(r)}</text>`,
      htl.svg`<text x=${M.l + cw * j + 2 + half + half / 2} y=${cy} text-anchor="middle"
        class="${"cellv" + (step(value(r)) >= 4 ? " on" : "")}"
        pointer-events="none">${value(r)}</text>`];
  }));

  const svg = htl.svg`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="ojs-chart">
    ${colKeys.map((ck, j) => htl.svg`<text x=${M.l + cw * j + cw / 2} y=${M.t - 9}
      text-anchor="middle" class="ax">${ck}</text>`)}
    ${rowKeys.map((rk, i) => htl.svg`<text x=${M.l - 8} y=${M.t + ch * i + ch / 2 + 4}
      text-anchor="end" class="ax">${rk}</text>`)}
    ${cells.filter(Boolean)}${labels.filter(Boolean)}
  </svg>`;

  function show(ev, r) {
    tipEl.innerHTML = `<div class="ct-h">${row(r)} \u00b7 ${col(r)}</div>` +
      detail(r).map(([k, v]) => `<div class="ct-r"><span class="ct-k">${k}</span>` +
        `<span class="ct-v">${v}</span></div>`).join("");
    tipEl.style.opacity = 1;
    placeTip(tipEl, ev, svg.getBoundingClientRect());
  }
  svg.onmouseleave = () => { tipEl.style.opacity = 0; };

  return htl.html`<div class="chart-wrap">${svg}${tipEl}${
    note ? htl.html`<div class="chart-note">${note}</div>` : null}</div>`;
}

// Generic x against y with a no-difference diagonal.
scatterChart = function (pts, opts = {}) {
  const { width = 1320, height = 300, note = "", xLabel = "", yLabel = "",
          unit = " mo", detail = () => [], colOf = () => "sr0" } = opts;
  if (!pts.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">Nothing to compare.</div>`;

  const W = width, H = height, M = { t: 14, r: 24, b: 42, l: 60 };
  const hi = niceTop(Math.max(...pts.flatMap(p => [p.x, p.y])));
  const X = v => M.l + (v / hi) * (W - M.l - M.r);
  const Y = v => H - M.b - (v / hi) * (H - M.t - M.b);
  const ticks = [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].map(f => Math.round(hi * f));
  const tipEl = htl.html`<div class="ctip"></div>`;

  const svg = htl.svg`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="ojs-chart">
    ${ticks.map(t => htl.svg`<g>
      <line x1=${M.l} x2=${W - M.r} y1=${Y(t)} y2=${Y(t)} class="grid"/>
      <line x1=${X(t)} x2=${X(t)} y1=${M.t} y2=${H - M.b} class="grid"/>
      <text x=${M.l - 8} y=${Y(t) + 4} text-anchor="end" class="ax">${t}</text>
      <text x=${X(t)} y=${H - 24} text-anchor="middle" class="ax">${t}</text></g>`)}
    <line x1=${X(0)} y1=${Y(0)} x2=${X(hi)} y2=${Y(hi)} class="refline"
      stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
    <text x=${(M.l + W - M.r) / 2} y=${H - 5} text-anchor="middle" class="axl">${xLabel}</text>
    <text transform="rotate(-90)" x=${-(M.t + H - M.b) / 2} y=15 text-anchor="middle"
      class="axl">${yLabel}</text>
    ${pts.map(p => htl.svg`<circle cx=${X(p.x)} cy=${Y(p.y)} r="5" fill="currentColor"
      fill-opacity=".62" stroke-width="1.4" class="${"pt " + colOf(p)}"
      onmouseenter=${ev => show(ev, p)} onmousemove=${ev => show(ev, p)} />`)}
  </svg>`;

  function show(ev, p) {
    tipEl.innerHTML = `<div class="ct-h">${p.k}</div>` +
      detail(p).map(([k, v, c]) =>
        `<div class="ct-r">${c ? `<i class="${c}" style="background:currentColor"></i>` : ""}` +
        `<span class="ct-k">${k}</span><span class="ct-v">${v}</span></div>`).join("");
    tipEl.style.opacity = 1;
    placeTip(tipEl, ev, svg.getBoundingClientRect());
  }
  svg.onmouseleave = () => { tipEl.style.opacity = 0; };

  return htl.html`<div class="chart-wrap">${svg}${tipEl}${
    note ? htl.html`<div class="chart-note">${note}</div>` : null}</div>`;
}

// Ranked horizontal bars, one row per item, with a per-row hover readout.
// value/label/detail keep it independent of any one dataset's field names.
rankChart = function (rows, opts = {}) {
  const { width = 1320, height = 330, note = "", unit = " d", cls = "sr3",
          value = r => r.v, label = r => r.k, detail = () => [],
          signed = false } = opts;
  if (!rows.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">Nothing recorded.</div>`;

  const longest = Math.max(...rows.map(r => String(label(r)).length));
  const M = { t: 8, r: 104, b: 24, l: Math.min(190, Math.max(64, longest * 6.4 + 14)) };
  const W = width, H = height;
  const rowH = (H - M.t - M.b) / rows.length;
  const bh = Math.min(rowH * 0.66, 22);
  // signed bars grow either side of a zero line; unsigned grow from the left
  const xTop = niceTop(Math.max(...rows.map(r => Math.abs(value(r)))));
  const span = W - M.l - M.r;
  const zero = signed ? M.l + span / 2 : M.l;
  const L = v => (Math.abs(v) / xTop) * (signed ? span / 2 : span);
  const Y = i => M.t + rowH * i + (rowH - bh) / 2;
  const ticks = signed ? [-1, -.5, 0, .5, 1].map(f => Math.round(xTop * f))
                       : [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].map(f => Math.round(xTop * f));
  const tickX = t => signed ? zero + (t / xTop) * (span / 2) : M.l + L(t);
  const clsOf = r => signed ? (value(r) > 0 ? "sr1" : "sr0") : cls;

  const bars = rows.map((r, i) => htl.svg`<rect
      x=${signed && value(r) < 0 ? zero - L(value(r)) : zero} y=${Y(i)}
      width=${Math.max(1, L(value(r)))}
      height=${bh} rx="2" class="${clsOf(r)}" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".85"/>`);
  const tipEl = htl.html`<div class="ctip"></div>`;

  const svg = htl.svg`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="ojs-chart">
    ${ticks.map(t => htl.svg`<g>
      <line x1=${tickX(t)} x2=${tickX(t)} y1=${M.t} y2=${H - M.b} class="grid"/>
      <text x=${tickX(t)} y=${H - 8} text-anchor="middle" class="ax">${t}${unit}</text></g>`)}
    ${bars}
    ${rows.map((r, i) => htl.svg`<text x=${signed ? M.l - 10 : M.l - 10}
        y=${Y(i) + bh / 2 + 4} text-anchor="end" class="ax">${label(r)}</text>`)}
    ${rows.map((r, i) => htl.svg`<text
        x=${(signed && value(r) < 0 ? zero - L(value(r)) - 9 : zero + L(value(r)) + 9)}
        y=${Y(i) + bh / 2 + 4}
        text-anchor="${signed && value(r) < 0 ? "end" : "start"}"
        class="${"ser " + clsOf(r)}" fill="currentColor">${
          signed && value(r) > 0 ? "+" : ""}${value(r)}${unit}</text>`)}
  </svg>`;

  const hits = rows.map((r, i) => htl.svg`<rect x="0" y=${M.t + rowH * i}
      width=${W} height=${rowH} fill="transparent"/>`);
  hits.forEach(h => svg.append(h));

  hits.forEach((h, i) => {
    h.onmousemove = ev => {
      bars.forEach((bar, j) => bar.setAttribute("fill-opacity", j === i ? 1 : .3));
      tipEl.innerHTML = `<div class="ct-h">${label(rows[i])}</div>` +
        detail(rows[i]).map(([k, v]) =>
          `<div class="ct-r"><span class="ct-k">${k}</span>` +
          `<span class="ct-v">${v}</span></div>`).join("");
      tipEl.style.opacity = 1;
      placeTip(tipEl, ev, svg.getBoundingClientRect());
    };
  });
  svg.onmouseleave = () => {
    bars.forEach(bar => bar.setAttribute("fill-opacity", .85));
    tipEl.style.opacity = 0;
  };

  return htl.html`<div class="chart-wrap">${svg}${tipEl}${
    note ? htl.html`<div class="chart-note">${note}</div>` : null}</div>`;
}

// Stacked columns: one column per row, one segment per named series, with a
// legend and a hover readout carrying the whole column.
stackChart = function (rows, opts = {}) {
  const { width = 1320, height = 330, note = "", segments = [], yUnit = "",
          label = r => r.k, detail = () => [] } = opts;
  if (!rows.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">Nothing recorded.</div>`;

  const total = r => segments.reduce((a, seg) => a + (r[seg.key] ?? 0), 0);
  const M = { t: 48, r: 22, b: 34, l: 60 };
  const W = width, H = height;
  const band = (W - M.l - M.r) / rows.length;
  const bw = Math.min(Math.max(6, band * 0.62), 74);
  const X = i => M.l + band * i + (band - bw) / 2;
  const yTop = niceTop(Math.max(...rows.map(total)));
  const Y = v => H - M.b - (v / yTop) * (H - M.t - M.b);
  const ticks = [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].map(f => Math.round(yTop * f));

  // one rect per segment, stacked from the baseline up
  const cols = rows.map((r, i) => {
    let acc = 0;
    return segments.map(seg => {
      const v = r[seg.key] ?? 0, y0 = acc; acc += v;
      return htl.svg`<rect x=${X(i)} y=${Y(acc)} width=${bw}
        height=${Math.max(0, Y(y0) - Y(acc))} class="${seg.cls}" fill="currentColor"
        fill-opacity=".85"/>`;
    });
  });
  const tipEl = htl.html`<div class="ctip"></div>`;

  const svg = htl.svg`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="ojs-chart">
    ${ticks.map(t => htl.svg`<g>
      <line x1=${M.l} x2=${W - M.r} y1=${Y(t)} y2=${Y(t)} class="grid"/>
      <text x=${M.l - 8} y=${Y(t) + 4} text-anchor="end" class="ax">${t}${yUnit}</text></g>`)}
    <text x="2" y="11" class="axl">${opts.yLabel ?? ""}</text>
    ${segments.map((seg, k) => htl.svg`<g>
      <rect x=${W - M.r - 78 * (segments.length - k)} y=${8} width="9" height="9" rx="2"
        class="${seg.cls}" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".85"/>
      <text x=${W - M.r - 78 * (segments.length - k) + 14} y=${16}
        class="${"ser " + seg.cls}" fill="currentColor">${seg.name}</text></g>`)}
    ${rows.map((r, i) => htl.svg`<text x=${X(i) + bw / 2} y=${H - 12}
        text-anchor="middle" class="ax">${label(r)}</text>`)}
    ${cols.flat()}
    ${rows.map((r, i) => htl.svg`<text x=${X(i) + bw / 2} y=${Y(total(r)) - 6}
        text-anchor="middle" class="ax">${total(r)}</text>`)}
  </svg>`;

  const hit = htl.svg`<rect x=${M.l} y=${M.t} width=${W - M.l - M.r}
                       height=${H - M.t - M.b} fill="transparent"/>`;
  svg.append(hit);
  hit.onmousemove = ev => {
    const box = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const px = (ev.clientX - box.left) / box.width * W;
    const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(rows.length - 1, Math.floor((px - M.l) / band)));
    cols.forEach((set, j) => set.forEach(rect =>
      rect.setAttribute("fill-opacity", j === i ? 1 : .28)));
    tipEl.innerHTML = `<div class="ct-h">${label(rows[i])}</div>` +
      detail(rows[i]).map(([k, v, c]) =>
        `<div class="ct-r">${c ? `<i class="${c}" style="background:currentColor"></i>` : ""}` +
        `<span class="ct-k">${k}</span><span class="ct-v">${v}</span></div>`).join("");
    tipEl.style.opacity = 1;
    placeTip(tipEl, ev, box);
  };
  hit.onmouseleave = () => {
    cols.forEach(set => set.forEach(rect => rect.setAttribute("fill-opacity", .85)));
    tipEl.style.opacity = 0;
  };

  return htl.html`<div class="chart-wrap">${svg}${tipEl}${
    note ? htl.html`<div class="chart-note">${note}</div>` : null}</div>`;
}

stepChart = function (rows, opts = {}) {
  const { height = 340, width = 1320, yUnit = " mo", maxLabels = 5, note = "",
          marks = [] } = opts;
  if (!rows.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">Nothing published for this selection.</div>`;

  const months = [...new Set(rows.map(r => r.ym))].sort();
  const groups = d3g(rows, r => r.key);
  const keys = [...groups.keys()].sort((a, b) =>
    (groups.get(b).at(-1).v ?? -1) - (groups.get(a).at(-1).v ?? -1));
  const labelled = keys.length <= maxLabels;

  const W = width, H = height, M = { t: 12, r: labelled ? 190 : 26, b: 34, l: 62 };
  const X = m => M.l + (months.length < 2 ? 0
              : months.indexOf(m) / (months.length - 1) * (W - M.l - M.r));
  const yTop = niceTop(Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.v)));
  const Y = v => H - M.b - (v / yTop) * (H - M.t - M.b);
  const ticks = [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].map(f => Math.round(yTop * f));
  const colOf = k => SERIES_COLS[keys.indexOf(k) % SERIES_COLS.length];
  const sorted = k => groups.get(k).slice().sort((a, b) => a.ym < b.ym ? -1 : 1);

  const rule = htl.svg`<line y1=${M.t} y2=${H - M.b} class="rule" opacity="0"/>`;
  const dots = keys.map((k, i) => htl.svg`<circle r="4" class="${"sr" + (i % 10)}"
                        fill="currentColor" opacity="0"/>`);
  const tipEl = htl.html`<div class="ctip"></div>`;
  // a series that ends does so for a reason; mark the month it happened
  const markAt = new Map();
  for (const m of marks) {
    if (!months.includes(m.ym)) continue;
    if (!markAt.has(m.ym)) markAt.set(m.ym, []);
    markAt.get(m.ym).push(m);
  }
  let lastLabelX = -Infinity, row = 0;
  const markRules = [...markAt.entries()]
    .sort((a, b) => a[0] < b[0] ? -1 : 1)
    .map(([ym, ms]) => {
      const stopped = ms.filter(m => m.kind === "stopped").length;
      const cls = stopped ? "sr1" : "sr2";
      const x = X(ym);
      // two rules a few weeks apart would print their labels on top of each other
      row = (x - lastLabelX < 46) ? row + 1 : 0;
      lastLabelX = x;
      const ly = M.t + 4 + row * 12;
      return htl.svg`<g>
        <line x1=${x} x2=${x} y1=${ly + 6} y2=${H - M.b} class="${cls}"
          stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4 3" opacity=".7"/>
        <text x=${x} y=${ly} text-anchor="middle" class="${"ser " + cls}"
          fill="currentColor">${stopped ? "\u2715" : "\u21ba"}${ms.length > 1 ? " " + ms.length : ""}</text>
      </g>`;
    });

  const svg = htl.svg`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="ojs-chart">
    ${ticks.map(t => htl.svg`<g>
      <line x1=${M.l} x2=${W - M.r} y1=${Y(t)} y2=${Y(t)} class="grid"/>
      <text x=${M.l - 8} y=${Y(t) + 4} text-anchor="end" class="ax">${t}${yUnit}</text></g>`)}
    ${months.filter(m => m.endsWith("-01")).map(m =>
      htl.svg`<text x=${X(m)} y=${H - 12} text-anchor="middle" class="ax">${m.slice(0, 4)}</text>`)}
    ${keys.map(k => {
      const pts = sorted(k);
      let d = "";
      pts.forEach((pt, j) => { const x = X(pt.ym), y = Y(pt.v);
        d += (j ? `H${x}V${y}` : `M${x} ${y}`); });
      return htl.svg`<path d=${d} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
                      stroke-linejoin="round" opacity=".92" class="${"sr" + (keys.indexOf(k) % 10)}"/>`;
    })}
    ${labelled ? keys.map(k => { const last = sorted(k).at(-1);
      return htl.svg`<text x=${X(last.ym) + 9} y=${Y(last.v) + 4} fill="currentColor"
                      class="${"ser sr" + (keys.indexOf(k) % 10)}">${k} ${last.v}${yUnit}</text>`; }) : null}
    ${markRules}${rule}${dots}
  </svg>`;

  const hit = htl.svg`<rect x=${M.l} y=${M.t} width=${W - M.l - M.r}
                       height=${H - M.t - M.b} fill="transparent"/>`;
  svg.append(hit);

  hit.onmousemove = ev => {
    const box = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const px = (ev.clientX - box.left) / box.width * W;
    const idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(months.length - 1,
      Math.round((px - M.l) / (W - M.l - M.r) * (months.length - 1))));
    const ym = months[idx], x = X(ym);
    rule.setAttribute("x1", x); rule.setAttribute("x2", x); rule.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
    const readout = keys.map((k, i) => {
      const pts = sorted(k);
      let best = null;
      for (const pt of pts) { if (pt.ym <= ym) best = pt; else break; }
      const dot = dots[i];
      if (best) { dot.setAttribute("cx", x); dot.setAttribute("cy", Y(best.v));
                  dot.setAttribute("opacity", 1); }
      else dot.setAttribute("opacity", 0);
      return best ? { k, v: best.v, c: "sr" + (i % 10) } : null;
    }).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v);
    const ms = markAt.get(ym) ?? [];
    const evLine = ms.length ? `<div class="ct-more">` +
      ms.slice(0, 4).map(m => `${m.kind === "stopped" ? "Stopped" : "Returned"}: ` +
        `${m.subtype} at ${officeName(m.office)}`).join("<br>") +
      (ms.length > 4 ? `<br>and ${ms.length - 4} more` : "") + `</div>` : "";
    tipEl.innerHTML = `<div class="ct-h">${ym}</div>` +
      readout.slice(0, ms.length ? 6 : 10).map(r =>
        `<div class="ct-r"><i class=${r.c} style="background:currentColor"></i>` +
        `<span class="ct-k">${r.k}</span><span class="ct-v">${r.v}${yUnit}</span></div>`).join("") +
      (readout.length > (ms.length ? 6 : 10)
        ? `<div class="ct-more">+${readout.length - (ms.length ? 6 : 10)} more</div>` : "") +
      evLine;
    tipEl.style.opacity = 1;
    const left = ev.clientX - box.left;
    tipEl.style.left = (left > box.width * .6 ? left - 252 : left + 18) + "px";
    tipEl.style.top = Math.max(4, ev.clientY - box.top - 30) + "px";
  };
  hit.onmouseleave = () => {
    rule.setAttribute("opacity", 0);
    dots.forEach(d => d.setAttribute("opacity", 0));
    tipEl.style.opacity = 0;
  };

  return htl.html`<div class="chart-wrap">${svg}${tipEl}${
    note ? htl.html`<div class="chart-note">${note}</div>` : null}</div>`;
}

bandChart = function (rows, opts = {}) {
  const { width = 1320, height = 300, title = "", note = "", marks = [] } = opts;
  const pts = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => a.ym < b.ym ? -1 : 1);
  if (!pts.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">Nothing published for this selection.</div>`;

  const months = pts.map(p => p.ym);
  const W = width, H = height, M = { t: 14, r: 132, b: 34, l: 62 };
  const X = m => M.l + (months.length < 2 ? 0
              : months.indexOf(m) / (months.length - 1) * (W - M.l - M.r));
  const vals = pts.flatMap(p => [p.lo, p.up]).filter(v => v != null);
  const yTop = niceTop(Math.max(...vals));
  const Y = v => H - M.b - (v / yTop) * (H - M.t - M.b);
  const ticks = [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].map(f => Math.round(yTop * f));
  const UP = "sr1", LO = "sr0";

  const both = pts.filter(p => p.lo != null && p.up != null);
  let band = "";
  if (both.length > 1) {
    both.forEach((p, j) => { const x = X(p.ym), y = Y(p.up);
      band += (j ? `H${x}V${y}` : `M${x} ${y}`); });
    for (let j = both.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) band += `V${Y(both[j].lo)}H${X(both[j].ym)}`;
    band += "Z";
  }
  const stepPath = acc => {
    let d = "", started = false;
    pts.forEach(p => { const v = acc(p); if (v == null) return;
      const x = X(p.ym), y = Y(v); d += (started ? `H${x}V${y}` : `M${x} ${y}`); started = true; });
    return d;
  };

  const last = pts.at(-1);
  const rule = htl.svg`<line y1=${M.t} y2=${H - M.b} class="rule" opacity="0"/>`;
  const dU = htl.svg`<circle r="4" class=${UP} fill="currentColor" opacity="0"/>`;
  const dL = htl.svg`<circle r="4" class=${LO} fill="currentColor" opacity="0"/>`;
  const tipEl = htl.html`<div class="ctip"></div>`;

  const svg = htl.svg`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="ojs-chart">
    ${ticks.map(t => htl.svg`<g>
      <line x1=${M.l} x2=${W - M.r} y1=${Y(t)} y2=${Y(t)} class="grid"/>
      <text x=${M.l - 8} y=${Y(t) + 4} text-anchor="end" class="ax">${t} mo</text></g>`)}
    ${months.filter(m => m.endsWith("-01")).map(m =>
      htl.svg`<text x=${X(m)} y=${H - 12} text-anchor="middle" class="ax">${m.slice(0, 4)}</text>`)}
    ${band ? htl.svg`<path d=${band} class=${UP} fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".10"/>` : null}
    <path d=${stepPath(p => p.up)} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.1"
          stroke-linejoin="round" class="${UP}"/>
    <path d=${stepPath(p => p.lo)} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.1"
          stroke-linejoin="round" class="${LO}"/>
    ${last.up != null ? htl.svg`<text x=${X(last.ym) + 9} y=${Y(last.up) + 4} fill="currentColor"
        class="${"ser " + UP}">upper ${last.up} mo</text>` : null}
    ${last.lo != null ? htl.svg`<text x=${X(last.ym) + 9} y=${Y(last.lo) + 4} fill="currentColor"
        class="${"ser " + LO}">lower ${last.lo} mo</text>` : null}
    ${marks.filter(m => months.includes(m.ym)).map(m => htl.svg`<g>
      <line x1=${X(m.ym)} x2=${X(m.ym)} y1=${M.t + 10} y2=${H - M.b}
        class="${m.kind === "stopped" ? "sr1" : "sr2"}" stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4 3" opacity=".7"/>
      <text x=${X(m.ym)} y=${M.t + 4} text-anchor="middle"
        class="${"ser " + (m.kind === "stopped" ? "sr1" : "sr2")}"
        fill="currentColor">${m.kind === "stopped" ? "\u2715" : "\u21ba"}</text></g>`)}
    ${rule}${dU}${dL}
  </svg>`;

  const hit = htl.svg`<rect x=${M.l} y=${M.t} width=${W - M.l - M.r}
                       height=${H - M.t - M.b} fill="transparent"/>`;
  svg.append(hit);
  hit.onmousemove = ev => {
    const box = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const px = (ev.clientX - box.left) / box.width * W;
    const idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(months.length - 1,
      Math.round((px - M.l) / (W - M.l - M.r) * (months.length - 1))));
    const p = pts[idx], x = X(p.ym);
    rule.setAttribute("x1", x); rule.setAttribute("x2", x); rule.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
    if (p.up != null) { dU.setAttribute("cx", x); dU.setAttribute("cy", Y(p.up)); dU.setAttribute("opacity", 1); }
    else dU.setAttribute("opacity", 0);
    if (p.lo != null) { dL.setAttribute("cx", x); dL.setAttribute("cy", Y(p.lo)); dL.setAttribute("opacity", 1); }
    else dL.setAttribute("opacity", 0);
    const gap = (p.lo != null && p.up != null)
      ? `<div class="ct-r"><i class="neutral" style="background:currentColor"></i><span class="ct-k">span</span>` +
        `<span class="ct-v">${Math.round((p.up - p.lo) * 10) / 10} mo</span></div>` : "";
    tipEl.innerHTML = `<div class="ct-h">${p.ym}${title ? " " + title : ""}</div>` +
      `<div class="ct-r"><i class="${UP}" style="background:currentColor"></i><span class="ct-k">upper bound</span>` +
      `<span class="ct-v">${p.up == null ? "\u2014" : p.up + " mo"}</span></div>` +
      `<div class="ct-r"><i class="${LO}" style="background:currentColor"></i><span class="ct-k">lower bound</span>` +
      `<span class="ct-v">${p.lo == null ? "not published" : p.lo + " mo"}</span></div>` + gap;
    tipEl.style.opacity = 1;
    const left = ev.clientX - box.left;
    tipEl.style.left = (left > box.width * .6 ? left - 252 : left + 18) + "px";
    tipEl.style.top = Math.max(4, ev.clientY - box.top - 30) + "px";
  };
  hit.onmouseleave = () => {
    rule.setAttribute("opacity", 0);
    dU.setAttribute("opacity", 0); dL.setAttribute("opacity", 0);
    tipEl.style.opacity = 0;
  };
  return htl.html`<div class="chart-wrap">${svg}${tipEl}${
    note ? htl.html`<div class="chart-note">${note}</div>` : null}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
fitted((w, h) => heatChart(HEATROWS, {
  width: w, height: h,
  note: `Mean ${pickHeat.toLowerCase()} in months, by form and year. \
Reading down a column shows whether that form recovered or deteriorated. Darker is \
${pickHeat === "Span" ? "a wider gap between the two bounds" : "a longer wait"}, on a scale \
set by the highest and lowest cell shown. Hover a cell for both bounds and the span.`,
  row: r => r.yr, col: r => r.form_name,
  value: r => pickHeat === "Lower bound" ? r.ml
            : pickHeat === "Span" ? r.sp : r.mu,
  detail: r => [["mean lower bound", r.ml == null ? "not published" : r.ml + " mo"],
                ["mean upper bound", r.mu + " mo"],
                ["span between them", r.sp == null ? "not published" : r.sp + " mo"],
                ["observations", nf(r.n)]]
}), { fallbackRatio: 0.42 })
```

```{ojs}
  return htl.html`<div class="dt-scroll"><table class="dt">
    <thead><tr><th>Form</th><th>Office</th><th>Subtype</th>
      <th class="r">Was</th><th class="r">Now</th><th class="r">Change</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>${RELROWS.map(r => htl.html`<tr>
      <td class="w">${r.form}</td><td class="w">${r.office}</td>
      <td class="k">${r.subtype}</td>
      <td class="r m">${mo(r.pu)}</td><td class="r b">${mo(r.nu)}</td>
      <td class="${"r " + (r.du > 0 ? "neg" : "pos")}">${
        (r.du > 0 ? "+" : "") + r.du} mo</td>
    </tr>`)}</tbody></table>
    <div class="chart-note">${NOTE2.release[0]}</div></div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
    .filter(r => r.form === pickForm && (pickSub === "All subtypes" || r.subtype === pickSub))
    .map(r => r.office))],
```

## Row {height="59%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: "Published bounds"
{
  const rows = ALLROWS.filter(r =>
    r.form === pickForm &&
    (pickSub === "All subtypes" || r.subtype === pickSub) &&
    (pickOff === "All offices" || r.office === pickOff));

  const keys = new Set(rows.map(r => r.subtype + "|" + r.office));
  // events for exactly the keys on screen, so a rule always explains a line
  const marks = DISCEVROWS.filter(e => e.form === pickForm && keys.has(e.subtype + "|" + e.office));

  // One series selected -> show BOTH bounds as a band. Otherwise upper bound only.
  if (keys.size === 1) {
    const one = rows.filter(r => r.up != null || r.lo != null);
    return fitted((w, h) => bandChart(one, {
      width: w, height: h, marks,
      title: pickSub + " · " + officeName(pickOff === "All offices" ? one[0].office : pickOff),
      note: htl.html`Both published bounds for a single series. The shaded span is the agency's
        own uncertainty, widen the selection to compare series on the upper bound alone.`
    }), { fallbackRatio: 0.24 });
  }
  const pick = r => pickMetric === "Lower bound" ? r.lo
                 : pickMetric === "Span" ? (r.lo == null || r.up == null ? null : r.up - r.lo)
                 : r.up;
  const series = rows.map(r => ({ key: r.subtype + " · " + officeName(r.office), ym: r.ym,
                     v: pick(r) == null ? null : Math.round(pick(r) * 10) / 10 }))
        .filter(r => r.v != null);
  return fitted((w, h) => stepChart(series,
    { width: w, height: h, marks,
      note: htl.html`Showing the ${pickMetric.toLowerCase()}. Hover anywhere to read every
        series at that month. Narrow to a single subtype <em>and</em> office to see both
        bounds together as a band.` }), { fallbackRatio: 0.24 });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Current bounds"
{
  const sel = ALLROWS.filter(r =>
    r.form === pickForm &&
    (pickSub === "All subtypes" || r.subtype === pickSub) &&
    (pickOff === "All offices" || r.office === pickOff));
  if (!sel.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">Nothing published for this selection.</div>`;
  const lastYm = [...new Set(sel.map(r => r.ym))].sort().pop();
  const now = sel.filter(r => r.ym === lastYm);

  return htl.html`<div class="dt-scroll"><table class="dt">
    <thead><tr><th>Subtype</th><th>Office</th><th>What it covers</th>
      <th class="r">Lower bound</th><th class="r">Upper bound</th><th class="r">Span</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>${now.sort((a,b) => (b.up ?? -1) - (a.up ?? -1)).map(r => htl.html`<tr>
      <td class="k">${r.subtype}</td>
      <td class="w">${officeName(r.office)} <span class="k">${r.office}</span></td>
      <td class="w">${shortDesc(r.form, r.subtype)}</td>
      <td class="r">${r.lo == null ? htl.html`<span class="m">not published</span>` : r.lo + " mo"}</td>
      <td class="r b">${r.up == null ? "not published" : r.up + " mo"}</td>
      <td class="r m">${r.lo == null || r.up == null ? "not published"
        : (Math.round((r.up - r.lo) * 10) / 10) + " mo"}</td>
    </tr>`)}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
```

## Row {height="61%"}

### Column {width="54%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: "Start vs. now, by office"
{
  const rows = OFFROWS.filter(r => r.label === pickOffice);
  const wantUp = pickBound !== "Lower bound";
  const wantLo = pickBound !== "Upper bound";
  const both = pickBound === "Both bounds";

  // one plotted point per office per bound: x is the first observation,
  // y is the current one, so the diagonal is "unchanged"
  const mk = (set, bound) => set.map(r => ({ r, bound,
    x: bound === "upper" ? r.fu : r.fl,
    y: bound === "upper" ? r.lu : r.ll }))
    .filter(p => p.x != null && p.y != null);
  const pts = [...(wantUp ? mk(rows, "upper") : []), ...(wantLo ? mk(rows, "lower") : [])];
  if (!pts.length) return htl.html`<div class="empty">Nothing published for this selection.</div>`;

  // with one bound on screen colour carries direction; with both it has to
  // carry which bound is which, and the diagonal alone shows direction
  const colOf = p => both ? (p.bound === "upper" ? "sr1" : "sr0")
                          : (p.y > p.x ? "sr1" : "sr0");

  const tally = b => {
    const set = pts.filter(p => p.bound === b);
    return { n: set.length, worse: set.filter(p => p.y > p.x).length };
  };
  const u = tally("upper"), l = tally("lower");
  const phrase = (t, name) => `${t.worse} of ${t.n} offices carry a longer ${name} bound now`;
  const noteTxt = both
    ? `${phrase(u, "upper")}, and ${phrase(l, "lower")}. Both bounds share one pair of axes here, so an office whose two points sit close together moved as a block, while a pair pulling apart means the agency grew less certain rather than simply slower.`
    : pickBound === "Upper bound"
      ? `${phrase(u, "upper")}. Anything above the dashed line got slower, in red, and anything below it got faster, in blue.`
      : `${phrase(l, "lower")}. The lower bound is the earlier percentile, so it moves when the quickest cases slow down. Red is slower, blue faster.`;

  const draw = (W, H) => {
    const M = {t: 14, r: 24, b: 42, l: 60};
    const hi = niceTop(Math.max(...pts.flatMap(p => [p.x, p.y])));
    const X = v => M.l + (v/hi)*(W-M.l-M.r);
    const Y = v => H - M.b - (v/hi)*(H-M.t-M.b);
    const ticks = [0,.25,.5,.75,1].map(f => Math.round(hi*f));
    const tipEl = htl.html`<div class="ctip"></div>`;

    const svg = htl.svg`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="ojs-chart">
      ${ticks.map(t => htl.svg`<g>
        <line x1=${M.l} x2=${W-M.r} y1=${Y(t)} y2=${Y(t)} class="grid"/>
        <line x1=${X(t)} x2=${X(t)} y1=${M.t} y2=${H-M.b} class="grid"/>
        <text x=${M.l-8} y=${Y(t)+4} text-anchor="end" class="ax">${t}</text>
        <text x=${X(t)} y=${H-24} text-anchor="middle" class="ax">${t}</text></g>`)}
      <line x1=${X(0)} y1=${Y(0)} x2=${X(hi)} y2=${Y(hi)} class="refline"
            stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
      <text x=${(M.l+W-M.r)/2} y=${H-5} text-anchor="middle" class="axl">first observation (months)</text>
      <text transform="rotate(-90)" x=${-(M.t+H-M.b)/2} y=15 text-anchor="middle" class="axl">current (months)</text>
      ${both ? [
        htl.svg`<g><circle cx=${W-M.r-140} cy=${M.t+9} r="5" class="sr1" fill="currentColor"
          fill-opacity=".72"/><text x=${W-M.r-129} y=${M.t+13} class="ser sr1"
          fill="currentColor">upper</text></g>`,
        htl.svg`<g><circle cx=${W-M.r-72} cy=${M.t+9} r="5" class="sr0" fill="currentColor"
          fill-opacity=".72"/><text x=${W-M.r-61} y=${M.t+13} class="ser sr0"
          fill="currentColor">lower</text></g>`] : null}
      ${pts.map(p => htl.svg`<circle cx=${X(p.x)} cy=${Y(p.y)} r="5.5"
          fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".72" stroke-width="1.6"
          class="${"pt " + colOf(p)}"
          onmouseenter=${ev => showPt(ev, p)}
          onmousemove=${ev => showPt(ev, p)}
          onmouseleave=${() => { tipEl.style.opacity = 0; }} />`)}
    </svg>`;

    // the readout always carries both bounds, whichever one was hovered, so the
    // two movements can be compared without switching the control
    const pair = (a, b2) => (a == null || b2 == null) ? "not published"
      : `${a} mo <span class="ct-ar">to</span> <b>${b2} mo</b>`;
    const signed = d => d == null ? "not published"
      : (d > 0 ? "+" : "") + Math.round(d * 10) / 10 + " mo";
    const cls = d => d == null ? "" : d > 0 ? "neg" : d < 0 ? "pos" : "";

    function showPt(ev, p) {
      const r = p.r;
      const line = (c, k, v, extra = "") =>
        `<div class="ct-r"><i class="${c}" style="background:currentColor"></i>` +
        `<span class="ct-k">${k}</span><span class="ct-v ${extra}">${v}</span></div>`;
      tipEl.innerHTML =
        `<div class="ct-h">${r.name} · ${r.code}</div>` +
        line("sr1", "upper bound", pair(r.fu, r.lu)) +
        line("sr1", "upper change", signed(r.du), cls(r.du)) +
        line("sr0", "lower bound", pair(r.fl, r.ll)) +
        line("sr0", "lower change", signed(r.dl), cls(r.dl));
      tipEl.style.opacity = 1;
      placeTip(tipEl, ev, svg.getBoundingClientRect());
    }

    return htl.html`<div class="chart-wrap">${svg}${tipEl}
      <div class="chart-note">${noteTxt} Hover a point for both bounds.</div></div>`;
  };

  return fitted(draw, { fallbackRatio: 0.42 });
}
```

### Column {width="46%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: "Spread across offices"
{
  const rows = SPREADROWS.filter(r => (r.form + " \u00b7 " + r.subtype) === pickOffice);
  const ups = rows.map(r => r.up).filter(v => v != null).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const fast = rows.find(r => r.up === ups[0]);
  const slow = rows.find(r => r.up === ups[ups.length - 1]);
  const note = !ups.length ? "" : htl.html`Every office publishing this form at the
    latest snapshot, one dot each, on a single axis. The upper bound runs from
    <b>${ups[0]} months</b> at ${fast.name} to <b>${ups[ups.length - 1]} months</b> at
    ${slow.name}, a spread of ${Math.round((ups[ups.length - 1] / ups[0]) * 10) / 10}
    times that depends only on where a case was filed. The shaded band is the middle half.`;
  // some subtypes are published only at directorate level, where there is no
  // per-office spread to show; say so rather than looking broken
  const empty = `This form and subtype is currently published only at directorate
    level, so it has no per-office spread. Subtypes of the same form that are
    broken out by field office will show one.`;
  return fitted((w, h) => stripChart(rows, { width: w, height: h, note, empty }),
                { fallbackRatio: 0.24 });
}
```

```{ojs}
        (d > 0 ? "+" : "") + Math.round(d * 10) / 10} mo</span>`;

      <th class="r">Lower at start</th><th class="r">Lower now</th><th class="r">Lower change</th>
      <th class="r">Upper at start</th><th class="r">Upper now</th><th class="r">Upper change</th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody>${rows.map(r => htl.html`<tr>
      <td class="w">${r.name} <span class="k">${r.code}</span></td>
      <td class="r m">${mo(r.fl)}</td>
      <td class="r">${mo(r.ll)}</td>
      <td class="r">${chg(r.dl)}</td>
      <td class="r m">${mo(r.fu)}</td>
      <td class="r b">${mo(r.lu)}</td>
      <td class="r">${chg(r.du)}</td>
    </tr>`)}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "Derivations"
dt_table(DERIV_R, mono = "Result", right = character(),
         prose = c("Input", "Rule"), note = sprintf(paste(
  "Assembled from %s daily snapshots spanning %s to %s, totalling %s observations of what",
  "USCIS published on each day. The agency publishes only today's figure and replaces it",
  "silently, with no changelog and no notification, so stacking daily snapshots is the only",
  "way to recover the history. Every number here is the agency's own; this project collated",
  "snapshots that were already public and did not collect them."),
  fmt(S$snapshots), S$start, S$end, fmt(S$rows)))
```
